newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada dollar ends firmer in steady trading.
newsitem.headline: Canada dollar ends firmer in steady trading.

text.p: * Canada's dollar ended firmer on Friday at C$1.3809 (US$0.7241) from Thursday's close of C$1.3818 (US$0.7236) in good two-way trade as the unit consolidated Thursday's gains.
* Traders said Canada's dollar strengthened after the Bank of Canada raised rates on Thursday, but all eyes were focused on next week's U.S. Federal Reserve meeting.

Recent economic data have shown little to suggest that inflationary pressure was growing in the U.S. economy, but Fed officials have said they would raise rates in anticipation of those signs to pre-empt a rise in prices.
On the crosses, the Canada dollar climbed to 83.07 from Thursday's 81.84 yen close and jumped to 1.2593 marks from Thursday's 1.2487 marks.
